finding: Both macrosomic infants of diabetic mothers (IDM) and macrosomic infants of non-diabetic mothers are at risk for significant morbidities, but IDM have higher risks of NICU admission and lower breastfeeding initiation rates.
mod_finding: Macrosomic infants of diabetic mothers were more likely to be delivered by cesarean section, while macrosomic infants of non-diabetic mothers were more likely to be delivered vaginally.
